scope: Chosen optional Boolean circuit tensor; no change to the default model or quantum/physical identification.
engine: universe24.core.Engine.step; no runtime gate callback or phase schedule
seed_convention: a=P(b): P swaps left/right where the retained control is 1; remainder[g,n]=(g*N+n) mod D

designated_one_way: Optional Boolean Fredkin circuit: a retained control selects a local swap. Its own value is unchanged, so the control-dependent terms are deliberately nonreciprocal, not derivatives of a shared physical potential. The exact involution proof applies to the prepared binary-control sector.
